website.data: Bimini Blue Custom Pools About Services Gallery Testimonials Contact Us About Services Gallery Testimonials Contact Us Scroll Where Home Meets Paradise. At Bimini Blue Custom Pools, there is nothing we enjoy more than building a place where family and friends can gather for years to come. An outdoor oasis where you can unwind from everyday life in the comfort of your home. See our Work Our Promise to you. Quality Craftsmanship Building a quality outdoor space is a significant investment and requires a great deal of trust on the part of our clients. For that reason, we only work with the very best to provide a level of craftsmanship that is second to none. Unparalleled Customer Service We are available for each of our clients throughout the various stages of the project, detailing what to expect and answering any questions that may come up. We provide the very best one-on-one care and attention to detail regardless of budget. Hear our Client Testimonials Bring on the Fun. Who says you have to leave your house to go on vacation? Bring the fun straight to you. Talk to one of our specialists to see how we can make your outdoor dreams a reality. Request a Quote Outdoor Living Pools & Spas Outdoor Kitchens Landscaping, Turf & Putting Greens Pergolas, Gazebos & Pavilions Outdoor Furniture & Umbrellas Meet the Owners Owners Michael and Bobby provide the total package—outstanding customer service and top-quality construction. The foundation for which they built Bimini Blue Custom Pools rests on their shared values and ideals including love for family and friends, a passion for serving others and most importantly establishing trust as the cornerstone of that foundation. Life is most enjoyable spent outdoors and the team at Bimini Blue is passionate about creating well-designed, top quality spaces that bring families and friends together to create lasting memories. Our Partners At Bimini Blue, quality is a top priority. For that reason we only partner with the very best industry leading suppliers and sub-contractors to bring our clients nothing but the best. Pentair , our exclusive supplier of pool equipment, is dedicated to efficiency, quality, and innovation. Their products offer long-lasting, sustainable water solutions for a reliable pool experience. ​PTI is an industry leader in pool finishes. They are recognized and trusted with over 25 years of experience and a solid reputation of excellence. Follow Us Bimini Blue Custom Pools Where Home Meets Paradise.
